en-US.author: Amariah Kamau
en-US.description: Atlarix in your terminal: the AI coding agent that works with any model.
en-US.longDescription:
Atlarix CLI is an AI coding agent in your terminal. It plans, builds, reviews and tests code
with you in any project folder, and runs unattended with `atlarix run` for CI and scripts. It
works with any model: Atlarix Auto, your own API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter
and more) or a local model through Ollama or LM Studio, and shares the Atlarix desktop app's
sessions, keys and settings.
en-US.name: Atlarix CLI
en-US.releaseNotes:
Context meter: the "context is at X% capacity" reminder and the context-bar percentage now
share one denominator - the model's full context window, so they no longer diverge. The
reminder still triggers compaction at the working window, unchanged.
